title: On Citing the very words of the letter
subtitle: 文学写作 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）
meta: 主题语境：文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）　|　核心词汇：cite　|　正文 356 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 cite 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1965 the herder ① cited the very words of the letter at once, and every neighbour in the pasture said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three winters on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the herder ② cites the very words of the letter in the rain without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ cite the very words of the letter at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ cited the very words of the letter before — a line in the ledger for December 1959 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Citing the very words of the letter at once, the herder said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the rope at the far pen, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ cite three cases from the past year in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Cite three cases from the past year at once and never mention it again.

By 1972 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the ledger, and a new neighbour from the next pasture ⑧ cites three cases from the past year at once every winter without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the pen, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ cited the very words of the letter again when nobody else would.

⑩ To cite the very words of the letter, my mother said in 1977, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the pasture remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the pasture forgets, somebody cites the very words of the letter in the rain again and somebody must cite the very words of the letter at once all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 引用（一般过去式 cited the very words of the letter：1965 年牧人头一回这样做，二话不说地）
B. v. 引用（一般现在 cites the very words of the letter：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 引用（不定式 to cite the very words of the letter：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 引用（过去完成时 had cited the very words of the letter：1959 年十二月的牧群台账上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 引用（动名词 citing the very words of the letter 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 举出（cite three cases from the past year：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去举出举出去年的三个例子）
G. v. 举出（cite three cases from the past year：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 引用（后段两处：新来的邻人照例 cites three cases from the past year，而母亲又一次 cited the very words of the letter）

answers.why: cite 意为“引用”，1965 年牧人二话不说地引用信里那几句原话，那是牧场里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 cited。
cite 意为“引用”，自那以后牧人淋着雨把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 cites。
cite 意为“引用”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯引用信里那几句原话”，此处为不定式 to cite the very words of the letter。
cite 意为“引用”，牧群台账里 十二月 那行字说明早在 1972 年之前就有人引用过，故用过去完成时 had cited。
cite 意为“引用”，牧人说“引用信里那几句原话这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 citing the very words of the letter 作主语。
cite 意为“举出”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去举出举出去年的三个例子”，should ever 之后用原形 cite three cases from the past year。
cite 意为“举出”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻举出举出去年的三个例子（cite three cases from the past year at once），以后再也不要提起。
cite 意为“引用”，新来的邻人每个冬天都照例举出举出去年的三个例子，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 cites。
cite 意为“引用”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次二话不说地引用信里那几句原话，用一般过去式 cited 叙述。
cite 意为“引用”，结尾那句是母亲 1977 年的话：要引用信里那几句原话，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和牧场记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1965 年，牧人二话不说地引用信里那几句原话；牧场里每一个邻人都说这是头一回。（cited the very words of the letter）
多年以后，牧人仍淋着雨做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（cites the very words of the letter）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯引用信里那几句原话这件事本身。（to cite the very words of the letter）
早在 1959 年就有人引用信里那几句原话，十二月那天牧群台账上的一行字就是证据。（had cited the very words of the letter）
牧人说过，二话不说地引用信里那几句原话这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（citing the very words of the letter 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻举出举出去年的三个例子，以后再也不要提起。（cite three cases from the past year，祈使句）
answers: In 1965 the herder cited the very words of the letter at once, and every neighbour in the pasture said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three winters on, the herder still cites the very words of the letter in the rain without being asked.
My mother said later that to cite the very words of the letter at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had cited the very words of the letter long before 1972, and the line in the ledger for December proves it.
Citing the very words of the letter at once, the herder said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
The rule the old hands handed down was plain: Cite three cases from the past year at once and never mention it again.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 cite 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1965 the herder cited the very words of the letter at once, and nobody in the pasture forgot it.
Even now the herder cites the very words of the letter in the rain whenever the pasture asks.
Citing the very words of the letter at once, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever cite three cases from the past year in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new neighbour from the next pasture cites three cases from the past year at once every winter, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother cited the very words of the letter again, and the pasture remembered that half.
